### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **5** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/liveness/action.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/state-counts/action.md`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**2** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-view.mdx`  _(via submitText (literal, a string literal in pushActionSubmitText; a string literal in sections))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx`  _(via submitText (literal, a string literal in pushActionSubmitText; a string literal in sections))_

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/liveness/action.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/state-counts/action.md`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **2** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **60** of **212** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **177** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json fa74b489308f0aded7d3434ebd65246519192022` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `182b71038c2c39787453384f8ad4f7346d58080e` — the merge of head `9d549390e4cd47770852aece9585be4323f9a41c` into base `fa74b489308f0aded7d3434ebd65246519192022`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 182b71038c2c39787453384f8ad4f7346d58080e && git checkout 182b71038c2c39787453384f8ad4f7346d58080e
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin fa74b489308f0aded7d3434ebd65246519192022 9d549390e4cd47770852aece9585be4323f9a41c && git checkout -B drift-repro fa74b489308f0aded7d3434ebd65246519192022 && git merge --no-ff 9d549390e4cd47770852aece9585be4323f9a41c

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json fa74b489308f0aded7d3434ebd65246519192022
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs fa74b489308f0aded7d3434ebd65246519192022` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `9d549390e4cd47770852aece9585be4323f9a41c`
Local-runs: none
Scope: ui/packages/types/src/ui-action.ts (`UIActionSchema.submitText`, derived), ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts (`ActionDef.submitText`) and actionKeys.ts (`ACTION_DEF_KEYS`), ui/packages/i18n/src/useObjectLabel.ts (`actionSubmitText`), ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx and views/RecordDetailView.tsx (the two `paramCollectionHandler` resolutions), views/ActionParamDialog.tsx (`ParamDialogState.submitText`, the submit button), the four action renderers' forward lines, packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts (`pushActionSubmitText`), packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts and system/translation.zod.ts (describe prose only), packages/spec/src/ui/action.form.ts (the `submitText` row), packages/spec/liveness/action.json (the row planned to live) and state-counts, packages/spec/src/system/metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts (the omit row removed), the platform-objects metadata-forms bundles, the regenerated content/docs/references pages, the eleven test files, .changeset/28158-action-param-dialog-submit-text.md

Inputs: card #28158 (the consumer half of #27944: both handlers resolve `submitText` as they resolve `description`, the dialog draws it with Confirm as the fallback and Uploading while a file uploads; the seat's claim 6540629779 and its amendment 6541924775 accepting the i18n resolver, the four forward lines, the spec prose trim, `ActionDef.submitText`; the dev report 6541916389), PR #28392 (body with the resolution order and the acceptance notes, the file list of 41 files, the diff of 968 lines against `main` read whole for every hand-written hunk, 10 commits from the merge-base), the 65 check-runs on this head (read 2026-10-31T10:41Z: all 65 runs completed, none failed, none cancelled, none in progress; success: Auto Label, Build & E2E UI, Build Core, Build Docs, Build UI Deps, Check Changeset, Check Documentation Links, Check PR Size, Dogfood Regression Gate, Flag docs affected by code changes, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Lint & Repo Gates, Lint UI, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Lint · ESLint, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · scoped · query-options erasure, Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Live E2E UI, PR-body guards (claim · duplicate · Part-of · single-writer path), Plan Test Core shards, Spec property liveness, Test Core, Test Core (all 8), Test UI, Test UI (all 16), Type Check UI, Type Check · consumer gates, Type Check · debt ledger, Type Check · source gates, Type Check · workspace, TypeScript Type Check, filter; skipped: 18.x upgrade harness (opt-in), Dogfood Regression Gate (matrix shard/3), Dogfood Verify CLI, Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in), Schedule gate · skip when a green push run covers the commit, Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL), UI Published Artifacts), and the tree on `main` for `ActionSchema.submitText` (`actionSubmitText()`, an `I18nLabel` refused blank and refused beside an empty `params`, landed by #28188), `translateAction` in `i18n-resolver.ts` (overlays the slot only on an action with `params`), `validate-translation-references.ts#checkActionSubmitText` (a slot under a paramless action is refused), the `actionDescription` resolver and the `actionSuffixes` node rule in `useObjectLabel.ts`, and `ActionParamDialog`'s submit button before this PR (`actionDialog.confirm` for every action). The head is mergeable and clean against today's `main` (`mergeable_state` clean); none of this PR's files moved on `main` since the merge-base.

### ① Derived judgments

- **The read point is the dialog, and both doors feed it the same way** - right. `useConsoleActionRuntime` and `RecordDetailView` each resolve `actionSubmitText(keyObject, action.name, pickLocalized(action.submitText, language))`: the bundle entry on the object node (`globalActions` for an object-less action, never for a bound one, by the shared `actionSuffixes` rule), then the authored inline map collapsed to the active language, then the authored string, exactly the order `description` takes. The dialog draws the resolved string, keeps `actionDialog.confirm` when it is absent or empty, and keeps `actionDialog.uploading` while a file param uploads. The parity pin (`DIALOG_READS`) holds the two doors to the same value.
- **The key reaches the dialog without being dropped a hop early** - right. `UIActionSchema.submitText` and `ActionDef.submitText` are derived from the spec field, `ACTION_DEF_KEYS` lists it, and the four action renderers forward it to the runner; the ui `check:action-forward-parity` gate reds without those lines and is green on this head. The runner itself never reads it (display copy), which the TSDoc says.
- **The spec changes are prose and ledger, not shape** - right. `ActionSchema.submitText` and the translation slot keep their type and refinements; only the "no renderer shows it yet" clauses leave their describes. The liveness row flips `planned` to `live` naming the read points, and drops `authorWarn` / `authorHint` in the same edit as the row itself required (#21127). The reconciliation omit row leaves and `action.form.ts` offers the row, so Studio can author a key the console now draws; the row is not gated on `params` because the parse refuses the key beside an empty `params` by name, so a misplaced label is refused, never kept unshown.
- **`os i18n extract` scaffolds only where the overlay reads** - right. `pushActionSubmitText` emits the slot only for an action with a non-empty `params`, matching `translateAction`'s overlay and the lint's refusal of a dangling slot; optional-not-derived like `description`. Pinned by seven cases, one of them a round trip through `ActionSchema`, extract and `ObjectTranslationDataSchema`; the ablation of the `params` guard reds the no-slot case.
- **Pins both ways** - right. Twenty new cases across the dialog, the two doors, the resolver and the cli, the identity-pin count moved by one, the forward-precedence test lists the key, and the partial `useObjectLabel` mocks in five sibling pins gain the passthrough.
- **Check-runs as gate verdicts** - read as above; every run on this head completed and none is red, cancelled or in progress at the read.

### ② Semver level

- **All eight packages patch** - accepted. The ui packages take `patch` for a non-protocol widening (`Clause-②: yes (widening)` is right: `UIActionSchema`, `ActionDef` and `useObjectLabel()` gain a member, nothing is narrowed); `@objectstack/spec` changes describe prose, a Studio form row and a ledger row with no change to any accept set, so `patch` and `Metadata-protocol: none` are right; cli and platform-objects gain a scaffold and regenerated bundles.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **`MetadataTypeActions.tsx` still says Confirm** - the third `ActionParamDialog` consumer (Setup's metadata-type actions) passes neither `description` nor `submitText`; outside the card, noted by the seat and not filed. Worth a card only if a metadata-type action ever declares `params` with a verb.
- **Surface beyond the order** - the i18n resolver, the four forward lines, `ActionDef.submitText` and the `translation.zod.ts` describe are each forced by the read point or a gate; the amendment accepts all of them.
- **No name approval owed** - no spec key is added; `actionSubmitText` is a ui runtime resolver named after its sibling `actionDescription`.
- **The seat lands** - no Tier H path (no `docs/adr`, no `skills/**`, 968 lines), no human gate.

### ④ Design judgment

- Tried: an action whose bundle entry is an empty string (the resolver answers `undefined`, the dialog falls back to Confirm rather than drawing nothing); an inline map lacking the active language (`pickLocalized` collapses to its fallback chain, as `description` does); a `submitText` that carries a `${…}` hole (not interpolated, by design: it is a verb, and the body says so). Keying the resolution off the same node rule as `description` is what keeps a bound action from reading `globalActions`. Nothing to add.

**Verdict reasoning.** The card's two doors resolve the key in the order the i18n layer already uses for `description`, the dialog draws it with the two fallbacks the card named, the key is carried on derived members and forwarded by every renderer so no hop drops it, the spec moves only prose and ledger rows with its accept set untouched, the cli scaffolds exactly where the overlay reads, the declarations and the patch level are right, the pins hold both ways, and every check on this head is green or skipped.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-16rt0c`
Reviewed-by: `session_01L9qibw58ehQ2gRHP2h2Puz`

**VERDICT: PASS**
